## What's changed

- Added an adaptive Discovery playback buffer that quickly builds up to roughly 80 seconds of server-side runway and automatically refills before playback reaches the edge. This improves recovery from brief provider or network slowdowns without preparing the entire video in advance.
- Reserved NNTP connection capacity for active playback so background imports and availability checks cannot consume every provider connection. Additional simultaneous streams receive their own playback headroom.
- Added live buffer and connection-pressure details to the dashboard and Playback Activity page, including current runway, refill events, active playback, reserved connections, background usage, and queued work.
- Improved Discovery source validation so sampled incomplete releases are rejected before playback instead of being imported as a degraded stream that can freeze later.
- Fixed H.264 NVENC playback failures with 10-bit sources by explicitly converting the encoder input to a compatible 8-bit format.
- Removed a misleading parser warning for files whose first segment was intentionally skipped during the optimized import path.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
